# Results — Study 16 (Storm-Shy) on real SPY / QQQ / EFA

*Generated by [`examples/verify.py`](../examples/verify.py). Daily split/dividend-adjusted closes,
period="max" — two US equity tapes (SPY, QQQ) and one non-US (EFA, developed ex-US), so the verdict
is not a one-market artefact. The offline core proves the machinery on a synthetic tape with a known
vol regime; this is the measurement on the market. As-of **2026-06-01**; match the per-tape fingerprint
below to confirm you hold the same tape. The vol-managed overlay is ``w_t = σ_target/σ̂_{t−1}``
(21-day trailing vol, 12%/yr target, 2x leverage cap, 1 bp charged per unit of exposure
traded). The bootstrap is a paired **circular block** bootstrap (blocks preserve the vol clustering
this very study trades; i.i.d. resampling gives intervals that are too narrow).*

## The verdict, earned — Signal `REAL` · Tradability `INVESTABLE` · Free lunch? `RISK-MANAGED`

Across **3** real tapes, realized variance is strongly autocorrelated (vol is forecastable — the
engine), and scaling exposure by its inverse lifts the net Sharpe in **3/3** of them at
**low turnover**, with a Moreira–Muir spanning alpha that is HAC-significant in **2/3**
and a bootstrap Sharpe gain whose 95% interval clears zero in **1/3**. The honest
catch — priced, not hidden:
the gain is a *risk-management* one (it needs leverage in calm periods, and a matched-risk CRRA
certainty-equivalent shrinks it to its real, smaller size), not free alpha. After fifteen mirages,
the desk's first **green** — and we say exactly what kind of green it is.

**The flag we will not bury**: on **SPY and EFA** the 95% interval for the Sharpe gain *contains zero* — SPY and EFA alone would not clear the bar. The stamp rests on **QQQ** plus the breadth of the published literature (Moreira–Muir 2017 across factors and markets), not on any one tape. A reader who weights only the in-house evidence should read the Signal stamp as `REAL` on QQQ and *directionally supportive* elsewhere. What holds on **every** tape is the risk-management half of the verdict: vol is pinned to target and the max drawdown collapses (SPY -55% → -39%; QQQ -83% → -38%; EFA -61% → -31%) — that benefit needs no significance test to bank.

## SPY — buy-&-hold vs vol-managed (8390 bars)

| | Sharpe | vol (ann) | max drawdown |
|---|---|---|---|
| buy & hold | +0.65 | 18.6% | -55% |
| vol-managed (net) | +0.76 | 13.2% | -39% |

- **Variance is forecastable**: log-variance AR(1) ρ = **+0.66**, lag-1
  autocorr **+0.49** — the overlay's entire input.
- **The overlay pays, cheaply**: net Sharpe gain **+0.11**, average leverage
  **0.96**, turnover **9×/yr** (a slow vol forecast ⇒ a few
  bps of cost, far below break-even).
- **The lift, honestly sized**: Moreira–Muir spanning alpha **+2.83%/yr**, HAC
  *t* = **+2.38**; circular-block bootstrap Sharpe gain **+0.11**,
  95% CI **[-0.06, +0.30]** (block 20),
  P(gain<0) = **10.8%**.
  **This interval contains zero** — SPY alone would not clear the bar; see the flag above.
- **The decay check — measured here, on this tape**: the rolling 5y *Sharpe gain* (managed minus
  buy-&-hold, paired windows) is **> 0 in 51%** of windows (median
  **+0.01**, range [-0.43, +0.47]), **-0.02** in the
  latest window; mean by decade of window end: 1990s +0.07, 2000s -0.08, 2010s +0.01, 2020s +0.15. A post-publication cliff would read as a
  slide below zero that *stays* there in the latest windows — judge the row, it is printed
  unconditionally.
- **The honest counter**: at matched risk a CRRA(γ=5) investor's certainty-equivalent gain is
  **+2.11%/yr** and the equal-risk excess CAGR is **+2.36%/yr**
  (drawdown -55% → -51%) — positive, but a re-timing of
  risk, not free return.

### Not a tuned point — net Sharpe gain across the vol-window × vol-target grid

| window \ target | 8% | 10% | 12% | 15% |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 10d | +0.11 | +0.11 | +0.12 | +0.13 |
| 21d | +0.11 | +0.11 | +0.11 | +0.11 |
| 63d | +0.12 | +0.12 | +0.12 | +0.11 |

Every cell uses the same machinery; only the vol window and target move. The gain's range across the grid is [+0.11, +0.13] — the sign holds across the whole grid, so the headline (21d, 12%) is a representative cell, not a found maximum.
